title: Ziyarat of Imam Ali on 17 Rabi al-Awwal
intro: The special ziyarat of Imam Ali associated with 17 Rabi al-Awwal in the selected devotional source.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Ali on 17 Rabi al-Awwal with arabic text and english meaning with available transliteration, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text: Recited on birth date of the Holy Prophet(saws)

blocks.english: Allah is the Most Great.

blocks.text: You may then say the following:

blocks.english: Peace be upon the Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon the elite select of Allah.
Peace be upon the bearer of glad tidings, the warner (against Allah’s chastisement),
and the shining lantern.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.
Peace be upon the pure, the immaculate.
Peace be upon the luminous epitome.
Peace be upon the one given victory and aid (by Almighty Allah).
Peace be upon Abu’l-Qasim Muhammad.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.
Peace be upon the missioned Prophets of Allah
and upon the righteous servants of Allah.
Peace be upon the angels of Allah
who surround this sanctuary
and this tomb to which they are resorting.

blocks.text: You may then approach the tomb and say the following:

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O successor of the Prophets’ successors.
Peace be upon you, O reliance of the pious ones.
Peace be upon you, O best saint among all saints.
Peace be upon you, O master of martyrs.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا آيَةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعُظْمَىٰ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O grandest sign of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَامِسَ أَهْلِ ٱلْعَبَاءِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O fifth of the People of the Cloak.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا قَائِدَ ٱلْغُرِّ ٱلْمُحَجَّلِينَ ٱلأَتْقِيَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya qa'ida alghurri almuhajjalina al-atqiya'i
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O leader of the white-forehead, pious group.
Peace be upon you, O shelter of the saints.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا زَيْنَ ٱلْمُوَحِّدِينَ ٱلنُّجَبَاءِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O adornment of the noble monotheists.
Peace be upon you, O select of the best friends.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَالِدَ ٱلأَئِمَّةِ ٱلأُمَنَاءِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O father of the trusted Imams.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَاحِبَ ٱلْحَوْضِ وَحَامِلَ ٱللِّوَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya sahiba alhawdi wa hamila alliwa'i
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O director of the (Divine) pond and bearer of the Pennon.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا قَسِيمَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَلَظَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya qasima aljannati wa laza
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O decider of Paradise and Hellfire—the flaming.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ شُرِّفَتْ بِهِ مَكَّةُ وَمِنَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man shurrifat bihi makkatu wa mina
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O one by whom Makkah and Mina have been honored.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بَحْرَ ٱلْعُلُومِ وَكَنَفَ ٱلْفُقَرَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya bahra al`ulumi wa kanafa alfuqara'i
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O ocean of knowledge and haven of the poor.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ وُلِدَ فِي ٱلْكَعْبَةِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man wulida fi alka`bati
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O one who was born in the Ka`bah,

blocks.transliteration: wa zuwwija fi alssama'i bisayyidati alnnisa'i
blocks.english: married in the heavens to the Doyenne of Women;
and the witnesses were the elite angels.
Peace be upon you, O lantern of light.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ خَصَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيُّ بِجَزِيلِ ٱلْحِبَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man khassahu alnnabiyyu bijazili alhiba'i
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O one whom was exclusively awarded abundant favors by the Prophet.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ بَاتَ عَلَىٰ فِرَاشِ خَاتَمِ ٱلأَنْبِيَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man bata `ala firashi khatami al-anbiya'i
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O one who replaced the Seal of the Prophets in his bed
and protected him with his soul against the evil of the enemies.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ رُدَّتْ لَهُ ٱلشَّمْسُ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man ruddat lahu alshshamsu
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O one to whom the sun was returned
and he thus became the match of Sham`un al-Safa (Simon the Zealot).

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ أَنْجَىٰ ٱللَّهُ سَفِينَةَ نُوحٍ بِٱسْمِهِ وَٱسْمِ أَخِيهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man anja allahu safinata nuhin bismihi wasmi akhihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O one in whose name and in the name of whose brother, Allah saved the Ark of Noah

blocks.transliteration: haythu iltatama alma'u hawlaha wa tama
blocks.english: when the waves of water collided and clashed around it.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ تَابَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِ وَبِأَخِيهِ عَلَىٰ آدَمَ إِذْ غَوَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man taba allahu bihi wa bi-akhihi `ala adama idh ghawa
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O one in whose name and in the name of whose brother, Allah accepted the repentance of Adam after he had allowed himself to be seduced.
Peace be upon you, O ark of redemption;
he who embarks on it will have saved himself (from perdition),
but he who leaves it will have perished.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ خَاطَبَ ٱلثُّعْبَانَ وَذِئْبَ ٱلْفَلاَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man khataba alththu`bana wa dhi'ba alfala
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he who spoke to a serpent and to a wolf in the desert.
Peace be upon you, O commander of the faithful.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَنْ كَفَرَ وَأَنَابَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi `ala man kafara wa anaba
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O argument of Allah against both those who disbelieved and those who believed.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا إِمَامَ ذَوِي ٱلأَلْبَابِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O chief of people of understanding.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَعْدِنَ الْحِكْمَةِ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya ma`dina alhikmati wa fasla alkhitabi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O essence of wisdom and clear judgment.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ ٱلْكِتَابِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O one having the knowledge of the Books.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مِيزَانَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O criterion on the Judgment Day.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا فَاصِلَ ٱلْحُكْمِ ٱلنَّاطِقَ بِٱلصَّوَابِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya fasila alhukmi alnnatiqa bilssawabi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O solver of all quarrels and spokesman of truth.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُتَصَدِّقُ بِٱلْخَاتَمِ فِي ٱلْمِحْرَابِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ayyuha almutasaddiqu bilkhatami fi almihrabi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he who gave his ring as alms while being in the prayer niche.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ كَفَىٰ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man kafa allahu almu'minina
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he through whom Allah sufficed the believers
in fighting on the Battle of al-Ahzab (the Allies).

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ أَخْلَصَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَحْدَانِيَّةَ وَأَنَابَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man akhlasa lillahi alwahdaniyyata wa anaba
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he who worshipped Allah alone with sincerity and always turned to Him.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا قَاتِلَ خَيْبَرَ وَقَالِعَ ٱلْبَابِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya qatila khaybara wa qali`a albabi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O warrior of Khaybar and plucker of the gate (of the fortress).

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ دَعَاهُ خَيْرُ ٱلأَنَامِ لِلْمَبِيتِ عَلَىٰ فِرَاشِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man da`ahu khayru al-anami lilmabiti `ala firashihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O one who, when the Best of Creatures (i.e. the Prophet) ordered him to spend that night at his place instead of him,
submitted to death and responded.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ لَهُ طُوبَىٰ وَحُسْنُ مَآبٍ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man lahu tuba wa husnu ma'abin
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he to whom is Tuba (bliss) and goodly return are decided.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَلِيَّ عِصْمَةِ ٱلدِّينِ وَيَا سَيِّدَ ٱلسَّادَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waliyya `ismati alddini wa ya sayyida alssadati
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O director of the safety of the religion and chief of the chiefs.
Peace be upon you, O owner of miracles.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ نَزَلَتْ فِي فَضْلِهِ سُورَةُ ٱلْعَادِيَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man nazalat fi fadlihi suratu al`adiyati
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he about whose merits Surah al-`ªdiyat was revealed.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ كُتِبَ ٱسْمُهُ فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ عَلَىٰ ٱلسُّرَادِقَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man kutiba ismuhu fi alssama'i `ala alssuradiqati
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he whose name is written in the heavens on the canopies (of the Divine Throne).

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُظْهِرَ ٱلْعَجَائِبِ وَٱلآيَاتِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O manifester of marvels and signs.
Peace be upon you, O commander in campaigns.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُخْبِراً بِمَا غَبَرَ وَبِمَا هُوَ آتٍ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya mukhbiran bima ghabara wa bima huwa atin
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he who accounted the bygone and predicted the future.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُخَاطِبَ ذِئْبِ ٱلْفَلَوَاتِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O speaker to a wolf in the desert.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَاتِمَ ٱلْحَصَىٰ وَمُبَيِّنَ ٱلْمُشْكِلاَتِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khatima alhasa wa mubayyina almushkilati
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O reckoner of pebbles and expounder of problems.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ عَجِبَتْ مِنْ حَمَلاتِهِ فِي ٱلْوَغَىٰ مَلائِكَةُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man `ajibat min hamalatihi fi alwagha mala'ikatu alssamawati
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he whose attacks in battlefields astonished the angels in the heavens.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ نَاجَىٰ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدَّمَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاهُ ٱلصَّدَقَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man naja alrrasula faqaddama bayna yaday najwahu alssadaqati
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he who offered something in charity when he talked confidentially with the Messenger.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَالِدَ ٱلأَئِمَّةِ ٱلْبَرَرَةِ ٱلسَّادَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya walida al-a'immati albararati alssadati
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O father of the Imams, the virtuous masters.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
Peace be upon you, O one coming immediately after the Messenger.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِلْمِ خَيْرِ مَوْرُوثٍ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of the knowledge of the most favorable inherited being.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the Prophets’ successors.
Peace be upon you, O head of the pious ones.
Peace be upon you, O aid of the aggrieved ones.
Peace be upon you, O shelter of the believers.
Peace be upon you, O provider of evidences.
Peace be upon you, O Ta-Ha and Ya-Sin.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حَبْلَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَتِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O firm rope (taking) to Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ تَصَدَّقَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ بِخَاتَمِهِ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya man tasaddaqa fi salatihi bikhatamihi `ala almiskini
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he who gave his ring as alms, while he was offering prayer, to a poor.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا قَالِعَ ٱلصَّخْرَةِ عَنْ فَمِ ٱلْقَلِيبِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya qali`a alssakhrati `an fami alqalibi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he who removed the rock from the open of the well,
and he thus caused the pure water to flow.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاظِرَةَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O observing eye of Allah,
His extended Hand,

blocks.arabic: وَلِسَانَهُ ٱلْمُعَبِّرَ عَنْهُ فِي بَرِيَّتِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa lisanahu almu`abbira `anhu fi bariyyatihi ajma`ina
blocks.english: and His spokesman who conveys His affairs to all of His created beings.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِلْمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O heir of the Prophets’ knowledge,
keeper of the knowledge of the past and coming generations,
bearer of the Pennon of Praise (liwa’ al-hamd),

blocks.arabic: وَسَاقِيَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ مِنْ حَوْضِ خَاتَمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa saqiya awliya'ihi min hawdi khatami alnnabiyyina
blocks.english: and one who shall serve his adherents with water from the (Divine) Pond of the Seal of the Prophets.
Peace be upon you, O head of the religion,
leader of the white-forehead group,
and father of the well-pleased Imams.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
Peace be upon the pleased name of Allah,
His radiant Face,
His strong Side,
and His straight Path.
Peace be upon the pious Imam,
the select and elite.
Peace be upon the brightly shining star.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلإِمَامِ أَبِي ٱلْحَسَنِ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: Peace be upon the Imam Abu’l-Hasan `Ali.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.
Peace be upon the leaders to true guidance,
the lanterns in murk,
the epitomes of piety,
the lights of true guidance,
and owners of thought,
the havens of people,
the firmest handles,
and the arguments against the inhabitants of this world.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon them.
Peace be upon the light of lights,
the argument of the Omnipotent Lord,
the father of the immaculate Imams,
the decider of Paradise and Hellfire,
the narrator of past events,
the destroyer of the unbelievers,

blocks.arabic: مُسْتَنْقِذِ ٱلشِّيعَةِ ٱلْمُخْلِصِينَ مِنْ عَظِيمِ ٱلأَوْزَارِ
blocks.english: and the savior of the faithful Shi`ah from their grand sins.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمَخْصُوصِ بِٱلطَّاهِرَةِ ٱلتَّقِيَّةِ ٱبْنَةِ ٱلْمُخْتَارِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `ala almakhsusi bilttahirati alttaqiyyati ibnati almukhtari
blocks.english: Peace be upon the one married to the pure, pious daughter of the Chosen Prophet,
the one born in the House of curtains,
the one married in the heavens to the reverent, immaculate,
content, and well-pleased lady—
the mother of the immaculate Imams.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.
Peace be upon the Great News,
about whom they differ,
before whom they shall be stood,
and about whom they shall be asked.
Peace be upon the most shining light of Allah
and the most luminous brightness of Him.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَحُجَّتَهُ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waliyya allahi wa hujjatahu
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s friend and argument
and Allah’s select and choice.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَحُجَّتَهُ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka ya waliyya allahi wa hujjatahu
blocks.english: I bear witness that you, being Allah’s friend and argument,

blocks.arabic: لَقَدْ جَاهَدْتَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ
blocks.transliteration: laqad jahadta fi sabili allahi haqqa jihadihi
blocks.english: strove in Allah’s way in the most appropriate way,

blocks.arabic: وَٱتَّبَعْتَ مِنْهَاجَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wattaba`ta minhaja rasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
blocks.english: followed the course of Allah’s Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household,
enjoined that which Allah has deemed lawful,
forbade that which Allah has deemed unlawful,
carried out His laws,
offered the prayers,
paid the zakat,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,

blocks.arabic: وَجَاهَدْتَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ صَابِراً نَاصِحاً
blocks.transliteration: wa jahadta fi sabili allahi sabiran nasihan
blocks.english: and strove in Allah’s way with steadfastness and well-wishing,

blocks.arabic: مُجْتَهِداً مُحْتَسِباً عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمَ ٱلأَجْرِ حَتَّىٰ أَتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
blocks.transliteration: mujtahidan muhtasiban `inda allahi `azima al-ajri hatta ataka alyaqinu
blocks.english: and with painstakingness and with the intention of seeking the great reward of Allah until death came upon you.

blocks.arabic: فَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ دَفَعَكَ عَنْ حَقِّكَ
blocks.english: So, Allah’s curse be upon those who deprived you of your right
and upon those who took you away from your position.

blocks.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ ذٰلِكَ فَرَضِيَ بِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man balaghahu dhalika faradiya bihi
blocks.english: Allah’s curse be upon every one who, when informed about this, accepted it.

blocks.transliteration: ushhidu allaha wa mala'ikatahu wa anbiya'ahu wa rusulahu
blocks.english: I call Allah, His angels, His Prophets, and His Messengers to witness for me that
I am the friend of him who is loyal to you
and the enemy of him who antagonizes you.

blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.text: You may then throw yourself on the tomb, kiss it, and say the following words:

blocks.english: I bear witness that you can hear my words
and see my place.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ لَكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ بِٱلْبَلاَغِ وَٱلأَدَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu laka ya waliyya allahi bilbalaghi wal-ada'i
blocks.english: And I testify to you, O Allah’s friend, that you conveyed and fulfilled.
O my master! O Allah’s argument!

blocks.arabic: يَا أَمِينَ ٱللَّهِ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: ya amina allahi ya waliyya allahi
blocks.english: O Allah’s trustee! O Allah’s friend!

blocks.arabic: إِنَّ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ذُنُوباً
blocks.transliteration: inna bayni wa bayna allahi `azza wa jalla dhunuban
blocks.english: Between me and Allah, to Whom all might and majesty belong, there are sins
that have overburdened my back
and deprived me of sleep;
whenever I remember them, even my insides shiver.

blocks.arabic: وَقَدْ هَرَبْتُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَإِلَيْكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa qad harabtu ila allahi `azza wa jalla wa ilayka
blocks.english: I thus flee to Allah, to Whom all might and majesty belong, and to you.
I beg you in the name of Him Who has entrusted you with His secrets,
appointed you as the supervisor over the affairs of His creatures,
matched the obedience to you to the obedience to Him,
and matched the loyalty to you to the loyalty to Him
that you may intercede for me before Allah,
rescue me from Hellfire,
and aid me against the vicissitudes of my time.

blocks.text: You may then throw yourself on the tomb again, kiss it, and say the following words:

blocks.english: O Allah’s friend!
O Allah’s argument!
O Allah’s door of forgiveness!
I, your adherent, visitor,
seeker of refuge with your tomb,
residing in your courtyard,
staying in your vicinity,

blocks.arabic: يَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَشْفَعَ لَهُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ فِي قَضَاءِ حَاجَتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: yas'aluka an tashfa`a lahu ila allahi fi qada'i hajatihi
blocks.english: (I) beg you to intercede for me before Allah that He may grant my needs

blocks.transliteration: wa nujhi talibatihi fi alddunya wal-akhirati
blocks.english: and may respond to my requests for this life as well as the life to come,

blocks.arabic: فَإِنَّ لَكَ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْجَاهَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
blocks.english: because you enjoy an enormous position with Allah,
as well as admitted right of intercession.
So, O my master, include me with those for whom you care
and include me with your party.

blocks.arabic: وَٱلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ ضَجِيعَيْكَ آدَمَ وَنُوحٍ
blocks.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka wa `ala daji`ayka adama wa nuhin
blocks.english: Peace be upon you and upon your partners in place; Adam and Noah.

blocks.arabic: وَٱلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ وَلَدَيْكَ ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka wa `ala waladayka alhasani walhusayni
blocks.english: Peace be upon you and upon your two sons; al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
and upon the immaculate Imams from your progeny.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.text: You may then offer a six-unit prayer of ziyarah; two for visiting Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), two for visiting Prophet Adam (peace be upon him), and two for visiting Prophet Noah (peace be upon him). You may also supplicate Almighty Allah as earnestly as possible, for your prayers are responded at this place, Allah willing.

blocks.arabic:
وَ هُوَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ اللَّهَ وَ أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ

السَّلَامَ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَ بِالرَّسُولِ وَ بِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ وَ دَعَا إِلَيْهِ وَ دَلَّ عَلَيْهِ

اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِي إِيَّاهُ

اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا ثَوَابَ مَزَارِهِ وَ ارْزُقْنَا الْعَوْدَ وَ إِنْ تَوَفَّيْتَنِي قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنِّي أَشْهَدُ فِي مَمَاتِي بِمَا شَهِدْتُ عَلَيْهِ فِي حَيَاتِي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّهُمْ أَعْلَامُ الْهُدَى وَ نُجُومُ الْعُلَى وَ الْقَدْرُ الْبَالِغُ مَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ خَلْقِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مَنْ رَدَّ ذَلِكَ هُوَ فِي دَرْكِ الْجَحِيمِ

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ تُسَمِّي الْأَئِمَّةَ وَاحِداً وَاحِداً وَ أَنْ لَا تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْ وِفَادَتِهِ وَ الِانْقِضَاءِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِهِ وَ إِنْ جَعَلْتَهُ فَاجْعَلْنِي مَعَ هَؤُلَاءِ الْأَئِمَّةِ الْهُدَاةِ

اللَّهُمَّ ذَلِّلْ قَلْبِي بِالطَّاعَةِ وَ الْمُنَاصَحَةِ وَ الْمُوَالاةِ وَ حُسْنِ الْمُوَازَرَةِ وَ الْمَوَدَّةِ وَ التَّسْلِيمِ حَتَّى يَسْتَكْمِلَ بِذَلِكَ طَاعَتُكَ وَ يَبْلُغَ بِهَا مَرْضَاتَكَ وَ يَسْتَوْجِبَ بِهَا ثَوَابَكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُكَ بِالْوَلَايَةِ لِمَنْ وَالَيْتَ وَ وَالَتْ رُسُلُكَ وَ أَنْبِيَاؤُكَ وَ مَلَائِكَتُكَ وَ أُشْهِدُكَ بِالْبَرَاءَةِ مِمَّنْ بَرِئْتَ أَنْتَ مِنْهُ وَ بَرِئَتْ مِنْهُ رُسُلُكَ وَ أَنْبِيَاؤُكَ وَ مَلَائِكَتُكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ وَ السَّفَرَةُ الْأَبْرَارُ

اللَّهُمَّ وَفِّقْنِي لِكُلِّ مَقَامٍ مَحْمُودٍ وَ أَقْلِبْنِي مِنْ هَذَا الْحَرَمِ بِخَيْرٍ مَوْجُودٍ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ
blocks.english:
May God‟s Peace, Mercy and Blessings be upon you. I entrust you with God, and I say peace be on you. We believe in God and the Messenger, what he has brought, what he has invited to and what he has reasoned. O‟ my God! Please do not make this the last time I visit here. O‟ my God! Please do not deprive us from the reward of visiting his shrine. O‟ God! Please bless us with the return. However, if You take away my life before this, I bear witness to what I testify in my life. I bear witness that they are the signs of guidance, stars high above, and means of connection between You and Your Creatures. I bear witness that whoever rejects this shall reside in the depth of Hell. O‟ my God! I ask You to bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny.”

Then name the Divine Leaders one by one and continue as follows, “Please do not make this the last time that I go to him and the termination of my visiting him. I ask You to intercede on my behalf near God for fulfilling my needs and demands for this world and the Hereafter. Please let me be with these Divine Leaders of guidance.

O‟ my God! Please smooth my heart with obedience, advice, friendship, love and submission until I complete Your Obedience with
this and attain Your Good Pleasure and deserve Your Reward and Mercy. O‟ my God! I bear witness to the Mastery of him whom Your Prophet, Your Messengers and Your angels declared as Master. I bear witness near You that I disown whoever You disown, and whoever Your Messengers, Prophets, nearby-stationed angels and Your Good Ambassadors disown. O‟ my God! Please grant me success in all praised ranks and let me return from here with the best benefits earned. O‟ Lord of Majesty, Bounty and Honor!

السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا تَاجَ الْأَوْصِيَاءِ

السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَأْسَ الصِّدِّيقِينَ

السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ الْأَحْكَامِ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رُكْنَ الْمَقَامِ [يَا صَاحِبَ الرُّكْنِ وَ الْمَقَامِ‌]

اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْ وَفْدِهِ الْمُبَارَكِينَ وَ زُوَّارِهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ وَ شِيعَتِهِ الصَّادِقِينَ وَ مَوَالِيهِ النَّاصِحِينَ وَ أَنْصَارِهِ الْمُكْرَمِينَ وَ أَصْحَابِهِ الْمُؤَيَّدِينَ وَ اجْعَلْنِي أَكْرَمَ وَافِدٍ وَ أَفْضَلَ وَارِدٍ وَ أَنْبَلَ قَاصِدٍ فِي هَذَا الْحَرَمِ الْكَرِيمِ وَ الْمَقَامِ الْعَظِيمِ وَ الْمَوْرِدِ النَّبِيلِ وَ الْمَنْهَلِ الْجَلِيلِ الَّذِي أَوْجَبْتَ فِيهِ غُفْرَانَكَ وَ رَحْمَتَكَ وَ أُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ وَ مَنْ حَضَرَ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِهِ فِي هَذَا الْحَرَمِ الَّذِي هُمْ بِهِ [فيه‌] مُحْدِقُونَ حَافُّونَ أَنَّ مَنْ سَكَنَ رَمْسَهُ وَ حَلَّ ضَرِيحَهُ طُهْرٌ مُقَدَّسٌ صِدِّيقٌ مُنْتَجَبٌ وَ وَصِيٌّ مُرْتَضًى وَاهاً لَكَ مِنْ تُرْبَةٍ ضَمِنَتْ [ضمت‌] نُوراً مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَ شِهَاباً مِنَ النُّورِ وَ يَنْبُوعَ الْحِكْمَةِ وَ عَيْناً مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَ إِبْلَاغَ الْحُجَّةِ أَنَا أَبْرَأُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ قَاتِلِيكَ وَ ظَالِمِيكَ وَ النَّاصِبِينَ لَكَ وَ الْمُعِينِينَ عَلَيْكَ وَ الْمُحَارِبِينَ لَكَ وَ أُوَدِّعُكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَدَاعَ الْمَحْزُونِ لِفِرَاقِكَ الْمُكْتَئِبِ بِالزَّوَالِ عَنْ حَرَمِكَ الْمُتَفَجِّعِ عَلَيْكَ لَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْكَ وَ لَا مِنْ زِيَارَتِنَا لَكَ إِنَّهُ [إنك‌] سَمِيعٌ مُجِيبٌ.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام علی ۱۷ ربیع الاول کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
